additional_checks.trigger: Pause transport.run_bounded after Processes.run has checked stop but before the process is registered; call cancel once, then resume process creation.
additional_checks.observed: The child started after cancellation and remained active until a second cancellation. A single cancellation can therefore miss a later registered SSH/rsync child and wait for its long original timeout.
additional_checks.expected: Synchronize cancellation with registration or make later registration immediately terminate/reap the child; retain prompt process-group cleanup on one cancellation.

additional_checks.trigger: Swap the banks parent directory only while Path.open acquires the file, restore the original directory before the read, and leave the bad canonical file metadata unchanged.
additional_checks.observed: The helper hashes a different good inode, then sees unchanged pre/post path stats for the bad canonical inode and reports already_complete=true.
additional_checks.expected: Compare fstat of the opened descriptor with the pre-open identity and check both descriptor/path stability after reading; apply corresponding descriptor checks to chunk reads and assembly publication.

execution_scope: All additional checks used temporary local files and real bounded local subprocesses. The actual remote program was executed locally with an injected parent-directory-swap race; no SSH/provider or model forward was called.
